assets.name: Website Recap
assets.description: A formatted summary for your church website
assets.instructions: Create a website recap from this sermon. Include: 1) A compelling title (3-5 words), 2) A 2-3 sentence summary paragraph that captures the main message, 3) 3-5 key takeaways as bullet points that are clear and actionable, 4) Scripture references mentioned in the sermon (format as 'Book Chapter:Verse'), 5) A 'Next Steps' section with one practical application for the week.

summary.description: 2-3 sentence summary of the main message

keyPoints.description: 3-5 key takeaways as clear, actionable points

nextSteps.description: One practical application for the week

assets.name: Small Group Guide
assets.instructions: Create a small group discussion guide. Include: 1) An icebreaker question related to the sermon topic, 2) The main scripture passage to read together, 3) 5-7 discussion questions that mix understanding (what did it say?), application (how does this apply?), and reflection (how does this challenge you?), 4) 2-3 application questions for personal reflection, 5) A brief leader tip for facilitating the discussion.

icebreaker.description: An icebreaker question related to the sermon topic

passage.description: Main scripture passage to read together

discussionQuestions.description: Discussion questions mixing understanding, application, and reflection

applicationQuestions.description: Questions for personal reflection and application

leaderTips.description: Brief tip for facilitating the discussion

assets.name: Weekly Email
assets.instructions: Create a weekly email summary. Include: 1) A warm greeting (e.g., 'Hi Church Family,'), 2) A 2-3 sentence recap of Sunday's message that's engaging and accessible, 3) A 'This Week at Church' section with 2-3 upcoming events (format as list items), 4) A call-to-action to watch/listen to the full message.

thisWeek.description: Upcoming events this week (format as list items)

cta.description: Call-to-action to watch/listen to the full message

assets.name: Leader Notes
assets.instructions: Create leader notes with theological insights. Include: 1) A theological insight explaining a key concept, word study, or biblical context (2-3 sentences), 2) 2-3 cross-reference scriptures that connect to this message (format as 'Book Chapter:Verse - Brief description'), 3) A key emphasis point for leaders to highlight when teaching.

theologicalInsights.description: Theological insight explaining a key concept, word study, or biblical context (2-3 sentences)

emphasize.description: Key emphasis point for leaders to highlight

assets.name: Devotional
assets.instructions: Create a 3-day devotional based on this sermon. Each day should include: 1) A day label (e.g., 'Day 1: The Perspective Shift'), 2) A 2-3 sentence reflection on that day's theme, 3) A reflection question for personal application. The three days should build on each other and connect to the sermon's main themes.

title.description: Title for the devotional series (e.g., '3-Day Devotional: Walking Through Fire')

content.description: 2-3 sentence reflection on that day's theme
